open_issues: Exports: apps/game has no export_presets.cfg yet. Godot only packs non-resource files that match the export preset's include filter, so any future preset must add `*.txt` (or at least assets/changelog.txt) or the exported game will show the 'changelog text is missing' fallback line and only the online button. Running from source is unaffected.

Every edit to apps/docs/content/docs/changelog.mdx now requires `python3 scripts/export_changelog.py` and committing apps/game/assets/changelog.txt, otherwise game:check (locally and in the game.yml CI job) fails with a pointed message. The Game checks workflow was not changed; ubuntu-24.04 runners ship python3.

The changelog screen's readability, scroll pace (260 px/s on held up/down; no auto-scroll) and the touch layout have not been played by hand or tested on a device; only headless checks and rendered 960x540 stills exist. The body clips its last visible line at the bottom edge, like the credits body does.

The 'newest heading' test asserts the loaded text starts with a dated '== ... ==' heading rather than a hard-coded date, so it will not need updating when a new date section is added; it does not verify that the date is chronologically newest.
I did not ask the user whether the changelog title ('DEVELOPMENT UPDATES') and the note line wording are what they want; both are easy to change in apps/game/scenes/main.tscn.

The ui_controls_test headline for the gamepad B check still relies on ui_cancel mapping; Escape in the changelog is handled through ui_cancel in `_unhandled_input`, before the pause_game mapping, same as the credits.

defects.title: Changelog screen promises drag scrolling that the body does not do; touch readers have no practical way to scroll
defects.location: apps/game/scenes/main.tscn:702 (ChangelogNote text), apps/game/scripts/main.gd:311-317 (_process scroll, only ui_up/ui_down), apps/docs/content/docs/controls/first-steps.mdx:12, apps/docs/content/docs/changelog.mdx:10
defects.detail: The in-game note, first-steps doc and the new changelog bullet all say the changelog scrolls with 'a drag'. The ChangelogBody is a plain RichTextLabel (selection_enabled=false, no gui_input handler); in a reviewer probe on the scratch copy (Input.parse_input_event) a 120 px InputEventScreenDrag sequence and a left-button mouse drag over the body both left the VScrollBar at 0.0, while wheel (0 -> 114), pan gesture (0 -> 1520) and a held Down key (0 -> 359 in 60 frames) did scroll it. The text is 3360 px tall against a 303 px page, so on a touch-only build (no wheel, no keys, touch_controls are hidden on the title) the only scroll target is the ~8 px wide scrollbar thumb. Either implement content drag (e.g. wrap the body in a ScrollContainer, or handle InputEventScreenDrag/mouse drag on the body and move the scrollbar), add on-screen scroll buttons for touch, or reword all three places to 'drag the scrollbar' and stop claiming drag in the touch guide. Probe was synthetic input, not a device test.

fix:followups.summary: Both defects re-checked against the code and both were real. (1) Drag scrolling: ChangelogBody had no gui_input handler at all (only the credits body is connected, and only to pause the credits), so the "a drag" claim in the in-game note, first-steps.mdx and the changelog bullet was false and touch-only readers had only the scrollbar thumb. Fixed in apps/game/scripts/main.gd by connecting changelog_body.gui_input to a new _on_changelog_body_input: an InputEventScreenDrag or an InputEventMouseMotion with the left button held moves the VScrollBar by -relative.y and accepts the event; mouse motion with device == InputEvent.DEVICE_ID_EMULATION (what Godot synthesises from a touch, since project.godot keeps the default emulate_mouse_from_touch) is skipped so one finger does not scroll twice. Wording in all three places now says "drag the text"/"by dragging the text"; the on-screen note was additionally shortened ("Source-build changes by date, not releases. Scroll with the wheel, drag the text or use up/down.") because the first longer wording clipped at the panel edge in the still. apps/game/assets/changelog.txt regenerated with scripts/export_changelog.py. flash() = white on IntroFade over red wash on IntroAlarm, pause-process and time-scale-ignoring tween, rest colours restored; rumble() gated on controller_active/touch; burst() for particles; enabled and reduce_motion flags), sfx_bank.gd (SfxBank: boom 0.5 s, small_boom 0.3 s, clank 40 ms, thud 80 ms, hiss loop 0.5 s, hum loop 1.0 s with 110/113 Hz saws, arc crackle 0.5 s; 16-bit mono 22.05 kHz, seed 0x574F4C46, every clip normalised to -6 dB; 4 voices + loop players on the Effects bus created after Settings configure; play(name, volume_db, pitch)/stop/stop_all; generation measured 16-19 ms), fx_presets.gd (sparks/dust_burst/steam CPUParticles2D factories), hazard.gd (Area2D on layer 4 scanning layer 1, engineer-only, armed flag fires contact when armed while inside or on entry), hold_use.gd (pure RefCounted: 0.4 s ticks, ticks persist on release/out of range, reset()). main.gd: _setup_impact/_setup_particles, effects_enabled now also silences Impact and SfxBank, Reduced Motion wired from Settings, _fail_beat(reason) (releases GAMEPLAY_ACTIONS, hit-stop 60 ms, red wash, trauma 0.6, strong rumble, thud, 70-degree tilt + 30 px slide, controls off 0.7 s, 0.4 s fade, then _load_game/_sync_scene from the checkpoint or the pre-checkpoint beat snapshot captured by _mark_beat at finish-intro/choice/arm/door-open; status line names cause then 'Back at the last autosave.'; Reduced Motion variant skips tilt/dip/shake), fail_active gate in _update_controls and _process, _cancel_fail in _new_game/_return_to_title, impact.reset in _sync_scene/_resume_game, end_hit_stop in _pause_game, hold_use advanced each frame with _hold_station() stub (returns empty until the junction valve exists). Proven on existing rooms: relay spark = clank + quiet arc + trauma 0.35 + rumble + colour-matched spark shower; seal landing = thud + dust + trauma 0.5; containment gate (intro step 2) = boom + white flash + trauma 0.6 + dust; Records exit = arc crackle + sparks + trauma 0.3 + 60 ms flash; breaker arm = soft clank. game_settings.gd: REDUCED MOTION CheckButton on the Display tab (video/reduced_motion persisted, reduced_motion_changed signal), Audio note now says Effects carries generated impact sounds. main.tscn: Human collision_mask 2 -> 10. Docs: changelog (3 bullets under October 8, 2026), controls/settings.mdx (Reduced motion row, Audio paragraph), controls/troubleshooting.mdx (no-sound row), development/status.mdx; assets/changelog.txt regenerated; manifest.json gains procedural-sfx-v1 entry and updated status line. open_issues: Feel, pacing and readability are not validated: no hands-on play, no ear test of the procedural clips (the manifest entry says so), no export or device test; rumble (Input.start_joy_vibration) and haptics (Input.vibrate_handheld) are wired but untested on hardware, and Android needs the VIBRATE permission in its export preset before haptics can work.

The hazard pattern uses layer 4 for hazards (Human mask now 10) but Area2D pairing is driven by the hazard's own mask on layer 1 with an actor_id filter; WOLF is filtered by id, not by layer, which is fine today but worth knowing when a WOLF-affecting hazard is designed.

Hold-USE is wired into _process through _hold_station(), which returns an empty id until the junction valve exists, so only the pure-logic suite exercises tick persistence; the scene-level proof comes with step 8 (room scaffold).
Shake amplitude: FastNoiseLite simplex rarely reaches +/-1, so practical peak shake at trauma 1.0 is roughly 4-6 px rather than the 10 px cap; tune after play if the booms read flat.

Godot engine quirk found: an AudioStreamPlaybackWAV stopped by a node leaving the tree is released by the mixer ~50 ms later, so any future headless suite that quits right after a sound should await ~0.1 s before quit() or it will print a leaked-instance warning (not a check failure).

The capture driver copy (game-blowback/review_capture/capture_impact.gd) was not committed, as instructed; the hazard rect in impact_test and the capture knockdown use a test cause string, not a real room hazard.

defects.title: Changelog overclaims a flash for every big moment
defects.detail: The bullet says the gate, relay contact, seal landing and Records exit 'each get a short sound, a brief camera shake, a flash and a spark or dust burst'. Only _shutter_boom and the Records exit call impact.flash; _flash_relay_spark (main.gd ~1340) and _door_lands (main.gd ~1285) add sound, trauma, rumble and particles but no flash. Reword to 'and, on the biggest hits, a flash' or similar, then regenerate changelog.txt with scripts/export_changelog.py. Fold into the next commit; not worth a separate round.

defects.title: Hazard comment and Human collision_mask describe a gate that does not exist
defects.location: apps/game/scripts/hazard.gd lines 3-6 and 10-13; apps/game/scenes/main.tscn Human collision_mask = 10
defects.detail: Area2D body detection in Godot 4 depends only on the area's collision_mask (1) matching the body's collision_layer (both actors are on layer 1); the body's own mask is irrelevant. The human's new mask bit 8 is therefore inert and WOLF is excluded solely by the actor_id check in _on_body_entered. Harmless today (tests and my probe confirm detection works), but the comment will mislead the junction work into relying on the mask. Either drop the mask change and fix the comment, or put WOLF on a different layer if a real physics-level exclusion is wanted.

defects.title: Rumble hard-wired to joypad device 0
defects.detail: controller_active is set from any InputEventJoypad* regardless of event.device, but Input.start_joy_vibration always targets device 0. A pad that enumerates as device 1 (second pad, or a reconnect on some platforms) gets no rumble while the docs promise it. Cheap fix: remember the last joypad event's device id in _note_input_device and pass it to Impact, or iterate Input.get_connected_joypads().

defects.title: SfxBank generation budget in the test is five times the spec
defects.detail: The spec asks for ~50 ms total; the assert allows 250 ms. Measured 16.3 ms headless on an M1 Pro (evidence/blowback/foundation/logs/sfx_bank_test.log), so the code is fine, but the loose bound will not catch a recipe that balloons. Tighten to ~100 ms or note why CI machines need the slack.

defects.title: Disabling the bank does not stop loops already playing
defects.detail: enabled=false only gates play(); hiss/hum loop players keep running, and _return_to_title/_load_game never call stop_all(). No caller starts a loop yet, so nothing is audible today, but the junction's hiss and hum will leak across a knockdown reload or Return to Title unless the setter (or _sync_scene) calls stop_all(). Flagging now so step 8 does not inherit it.

defects.title: Restore line says 'autosave' on the pre-checkpoint snapshot path
defects.detail: Before the safe point nothing is on disk; the knockdown restores beat_snapshot. The player cannot tell the difference, so this is wording only, but 'Back at the start of this beat.' would be true on both paths (impact_test asserts the current text, so adjust that assert together).

implement:blowback-1.summary:
Implemented Blowback beats 1-3 (Service Junction entry, pressure line charge, door blast) in the worktree [session scratch, not kept]/wt-game (branch codex/game-presentation), one commit 41087ed on top of b77c654; not pushed.

Changes:
- apps/game/scripts/m0_state.gd: SAVE_VERSION 4, CHAPTER_IDS adds "junction"; fields door_blown/sentry_down/junction_cleared (all three in the save format so later beats need no v5); guards enter_junction() (requires records + chapter_complete, places actors at 120/64) and blow_door(); ordered validation (junction only in v>=4, requires chapter_complete; sentry_down needs door_blown; junction_cleared needs sentry_down; flags must be false outside the junction); v<=3 saves default the new fields.
- apps/game/scripts/pressure_line.gd (new, RefCounted pure logic): arm() from idle/tripped, advance(delta) returns "tripped"/"fuse"/"blown", crank(held_delta) -> 0.4 s per turn, 3 turns -> charged -> fuse 1.0 s -> blown; gauge 0..1 over 6 s; release(), paused flag, static is_in_blast(x) 360..540 and is_on_vent(x) 250..350; epsilon on boundaries so sliced deltas match whole ones.
- apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd (new JunctionRoom Node2D, records_room.gd pattern): RoomDepth with the registered corridor painting tinted warmer/darker (no pixel edits), reused breaker and seal prop regions, code-drawn entry hatch, pressure pipe run that warms with the gauge, relief vent grate + steam (velocity/scale/alpha follow gauge), gauge dial, three turn lights, ValveWheel inner Node2D rotating 90 deg per turn, seam glow (amber with gauge, strobing white once charged), sealed door StaticBody2D 56x132 on layer 2 crushed by a scale tween on the blast, rubble, closed exit hatch; two Hazard areas (vent 250..350, blast 360..540) armed for 0.4 s by real events only; set_active() keeps the door body and hazard monitoring off outside the junction (rooms share coordinates); reset_transient() for every scene sync.
- apps/game/scripts/main.gd: junction_room under Main; _enter_junction() from USE at the secured Records exit (replaces the "Archive trail is next" branch; the closing beat is kept); _interact_junction, _tick_junction (hold_use drives PressureLine.crank, events -> _vent_trips/_door_blast, hiss volume and hum pitch as functions of gauge), _valve_turned (click, weak rumble, klaxon on turn 3), _door_blast (in the blast zone: boom feedback + _fail_beat with no state change; otherwise blow_door, door crush, rubble, WOLF holds at 500, autosave B), WOLF scouting to the seam then back to follow (_wolf_target_x), _sync_junction_room in _sync_scene, _hold_station returns "valve" while building, touch USE relabels to CRANK, SERVICE JUNCTION top card, objectives CLEAR THE LINE / CHARGE THE SEAL / CLEAR THE DOOR / DOOR DOWN, junction context hints, Continue status lines, hint hidden during a knockdown, loops stopped on Return to Title. Pause/Back unchanged (fail_active already covered).
- apps/game/scripts/sfx_bank.gd: two generated clips, klaxon (3 x 120 ms square chirps) and growl (70 Hz saw with 9 Hz tremolo); no new files.
- apps/game/tests/junction_test.gd (new): PressureLine timing (trip at 6 s, turn boundaries, release keeps turns, fuse 1.0 s, paused no-op, blast/vent ranges), v4 format/ordering and a literal v3 fixture that still loads and can enter the junction, scene route: entry from a completed Records save with autosave A, WOLF scout and return, door blocks, pause freezes the line, hold-USE turns persist across release, CRANK label, blast-zone knockdown restores A byte-for-byte with memory intact and resets line/hazards/door, clean blast -> door_blown, autosave B, time_scale/camera settle, walk through, WOLF stays at the rubble, Continue restores B, New Game disables the junction door body.
- Docs: new apps/docs/content/docs/walkthrough/service-junction.mdx; walkthrough index/meta/records-access, controls input/saves/troubleshooting, development status/index/testing, index, about, get-game updated; two spoiler-free bullets under "## October 8, 2026" in changelog.mdx; apps/game/assets/changelog.txt regenerated.
- apps/game/assets/manifest.json: corridor painting and maintenance props entries note the junction reuse (runtime tint only), procedural-sfx entry lists nine clips and the junction uses, status line updated. No new PNG/WAV.

Deviation from the spec: WOLF's seam read point is x 418, not 440, because his 62 px body collides with the door body starting at x 452 (he cannot physically reach 440); WOLF_SEAM_X is a named constant in junction_room.gd.
implement:blowback-1.checks: From the worktree: `bun run game:check` (isolated HOME, import twice, all nine suites) passed twice after the final code: chapter_scene_test, hold_use_test, impact_test, junction_test, m0_scene_test, m0_state_test, settings_test, sfx_bank_test, ui_controls_test; working tree unchanged by the checks. `bun run docs:check` passed (types generated, exit 0). manifest.json validated as JSON. Rendered stills captured with the normal renderer via a scratch copy and a review-only driver (game-blowback/review_capture/capture_junction.gd, not committed) with auto_pause_on_focus_loss off; capture notes: no failed walks, time_scale 0.05 at the blast knockdown hit frame, after each restore x=120 door_blown=false, after the clean blast trauma 0 / offset (0,0) / time_scale 1.0 / WOLF target 500, WOLF x 500 after the engineer crosses. These are headless logic checks and rendered stills only: no hands-on play, no export or device test, so feel, pacing, fuse fairness and readability are not validated.
open_issues: WOLF reads the seam at x 418 instead of the spec's 440: his 62 px body stops at the door body (x 452). Later steps that bait the sentry should reuse JunctionRoom.WOLF_SEAM_X / WOLF_RUBBLE_X rather than literal spec numbers.

The 1.0 s fuse, the 6 s gauge and the 0.4 s hazard windows are untuned: no hands-on play has happened, so fairness (especially on touch, where the spec suggests +0.2 s) and whether the first knockdown reads as the player's fault remain open.
The junction backdrop is the corridor painting tinted at runtime plus code-drawn fixtures; a room painting of its own is still needed (registered in the manifest as a reuse, no new assets).

Beats 4-6 (rubble choice, sentry, drop arm, exit bolt) are not built: past the door there is no station; the hint says the lane is next. State fields sentry_down/junction_cleared and their validation already exist in save v4 so no v5 bump is needed; guards drop_sentry/clear_junction are not yet written.
Audio: klaxon and growl (and every clip) are first-pass procedural recipes, not ear-tested in a normal window.

Reduced Motion in the junction follows the shared Impact kit (no shake/hit-stop, shorter flashes); the seam strobe tween and vent steam still animate with it on, which may want a check with the Settings toggle.
A hazard-aware walking helper for tests was not needed for beats 1-3 (hazards arm only for 0.4 s windows); later beats with a patrolling sentry will need one.

defects.title: Door blast can knock down AND blow the door + autosave B in the same frame (hazard body-overlap disagrees with is_in_blast)
defects.location: apps/game/scripts/main.gd `_door_blast()` (lines ~1335-1346) with apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd `blast_hazard = Hazard.make(... Rect2(360, 300, 180, 140) ...)` (~line 118) and `door_blast()` -> `_arm_hazard(blast_hazard)`
defects.detail: `_door_blast` decides the knockdown from the engineer's centre (`PressureLine.is_in_blast(human.position.x)`, 360..540) but then `junction_room.door_blast()` arms an Area2D whose overlap test uses the 28 px body, so the effective zone is 346..554. For a centre in 346..359 the order is: `blow_door()` succeeds, the hazard's `armed` setter emits `contact` synchronously, `_fail_beat(BLAST_REASON)` runs, then `_door_blast` continues: overwrites `status_line` with "The seal goes...", and `_save_progress()` writes autosave B with `door_blown = true` while `fail_active` is true. The restore then reloads B. CONFIRMED headless (scratch probe [session scratch, not kept]/game-blowback/review_capture/probe_review.gd, log [session scratch, not kept]/review-probe-blowback.log): at x 352 -> `door_blown=true fail_active=true saved_door_blown=true`, and after the fade the engineer is still at 352 with the door gone and the line "The door blew with you in front of it. Get left of the vent before the fuse ends. | Back at the last autosave." The player gets a knockdown that restores nothing, the door is down, and the status text contradicts the room. Reachable by anyone who stops just short of the vent while following the hint "Get left of the vent". Fix: use one source of truth (e.g. a `Hazard.has_engineer()` check or `human.position.x >= BLAST_MIN_X - 14.0`) before `state.blow_door()`, and/or return early if `fail_active` is set after `junction_room.door_blast()` so no autosave is written during a knockdown.

defects.title: Relief-vent kill zone is wider than the hint, the is_on_vent range and the drawn grate
defects.location: apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd `vent_hazard = Hazard.make("VentHazard", Rect2(250, 380, 100, 60), ...)` (~line 117) and `_draw_vent()` (grate 60 px at VENT_X +/- 30); apps/game/scripts/main.gd `_junction_hint()` (`PressureLine.is_on_vent`)
defects.detail: The hazard rect is 250..350 and the body overlap adds 14 px each side, so the knockdown zone is 236..364 while the hint/`is_on_vent` cover 250..350 and the visible grate only 270..330. CONFIRMED headless: engineer at x 242 (inside the breaker's +/-52 range) sees the hint "E: arm the overload breaker.", arms the line, and 6 s later gets "The relief vent let go under you." with no vent hint ever shown. The spec puts the vent zone at 250..350; either shrink the hazard rect by the body half-width (222..336 -> use Rect2(264, ..., 72, ...)) or make `is_on_vent`/the hint use the same extents and widen the grate drawing so the zone is readable. Not hands-on validated; this is a geometry mismatch, not a feel claim.

defects.title: Gauge dial overlaps the VALVE / SEAL CHARGED station label
defects.location: apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd `_draw_gauge_and_lights()` centre Vector2(VALVE_X - 48, 326) radius 18 vs `valve_label` (position VALVE_X - 90, y 309, size 180x30) in `_ready()`
defects.detail: Stills 30-valve-hint-gauge-rising.png, 33-seal-charged.png, 41-blast-knockdown-tilt.png and 53-door-down-rubble.png under [session scratch, not kept]/evidence/blowback/beats-1-3/ show the dial drawn over the label: "VALVE 0 / 3" starts at the dial's edge and the S of "SEAL CHARGED" is hidden under the dial. The code comment says both are "clear of the station label", which is not the case. Move the dial up/left (e.g. y 290 on the pipe run or x VALVE_X - 70) or shift the label.

defects.title: Crafted v4 junction save can place the engineer behind the sealed door; Continue then strands them
defects.detail: CONFIRMED: a v4 save with chapter_id "junction", door_blown false and human x 600 loads (`from_dict != null`). In play the door body (452..508) then blocks the way back to the valve (368..472) and the breaker, so that save is unplayable until New Game. No legitimate path produces it (autosave A is at x 120, B only after the blast), so this is a validation-hardening gap in the spirit of the existing cross-field checks (`door_open == (route != "")`), not a progress bug: reject `chapter_id == "junction" and not door_blown and human x > 438` (or >= 452).

defects.title: Breaker label reads BREAKER LIVE after the door is blown while USE says the breaker is spent
defects.location: apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd `refresh_state()` (`armed = line_state != &"idle" and line_state != &"tripped"` includes `blown`); apps/game/scripts/main.gd `_interact_junction()` ("The breaker is spent. The door is down.")
defects.detail: Stills 53 and 55 show "BREAKER LIVE" and "VALVE 3 / 3" after the blast, and on a Continue with door_blown the line is reset to idle so the same room shows "OVERLOAD BREAKER" instead; the two post-blast states disagree with each other and with the interact text. Cosmetic; treat `blown` (and door_blown) as spent in `refresh_state()`.

defects.title: Knockdown reaction is hidden by WOLF's sprite and by the opaque vent puff in the stills
defects.location: Stills [session scratch, not kept]/evidence/blowback/beats-1-3/23-vent-knockdown-tilt.png and 41-blast-knockdown-tilt.png; apps/game/scripts/main.gd `_ready()` (`human.z_index = 2`, `wolf.z_index = 2`, WOLF later in the tree); junction_room.gd `_build_particles()` `vent_puff` (dust_burst, STEAM at alpha 0.7, amount 28)
defects.detail: In 41 the engineer's 70-degree tilt is behind WOLF, who follows at the 64 px gap and whose sprite is wider than that at the valve; in 23 the vent burst is a solid white disc covering the breaker, grate and engineer, so the cause of the knockdown is not visible in the frame that should read it. The z-order is pre-existing, but this room is the first place a knockdown has to read. Suggest drawing the engineer above WOLF (z 3) and lowering the puff alpha/amount. Readability note from stills only; nothing about feel is claimed or validated.
